h1: Custom Flannel Outerwear for Branded Uniforms
metaDescription: Order custom flannel outerwear for your team. Perfect for uniforms and giveaways. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flannel outerwear offers a rugged, comfortable look that stands out from standard polyester jackets. The soft brushed cotton or cotton-blend fabric provides warmth without bulk, making it ideal for outdoor events, construction sites, or casual office wear. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a durable logo that lasts. Bulk orders ensure consistent sizing and color across your entire team.
heroAltText: Custom flannel outerwear with embroidered logo, available in bulk for corporate uniforms
